blocks.text: If you configure the Zscaler Admin Console as your identity provider (IdP), users automatically enroll with Zscaler Client Connector. Users and their devices authenticate using a device token generated in the Zscaler Admin Console.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Client Connector IdP.
In the Create Device Token drawer, do the following:

Enter Password: Enter a password that is at least six characters and includes at least one alphabetic character and a number. This password is only for generating the token and is unneeded after that.
Token Description: Enter a description that will help you track the device token.

blocks.text: The token you generate appears in the table on the Client Connector IdP page. You can create up to 16 tokens.
